description: Backend Module Integration and Seeding - Install @nestjs/axios package, wire up JobRolesModule and InterviewsModule in AppModule, implement OnModuleInit to seed default job roles on startup. This completes the backend module wiring so interview endpoints become functional.
steps: Edit backend/package.json: add '@nestjs/axios': '^3.0.1' to dependencies object
Edit backend/src/app.module.ts: import JobRolesModule from './job-roles/job-roles.module' and InterviewsModule from './interviews/interviews.module'
Add JobRolesModule and InterviewsModule to the imports array (after ResumesModule)
Import OnModuleInit from @nestjs/common and JobRolesService from ./job-roles/job-roles.service
Add 'implements OnModuleInit' to AppModule class declaration
Implement async onModuleInit() { await this.jobRolesService.seedDefaultRoles(); } — this runs once on app startup and seeds 10 default job roles if none exist
acceptance_criteria: @nestjs/axios installed in node_modules and listed in package.json dependencies
JobRolesModule and InterviewsModule imported and registered in AppModule
Server starts without module resolution errors
GET /api/v1/job-roles returns 10 seeded roles after first startup
verification: cd backend && npm install — completes without errors
cd backend && npm run start:dev — server starts and logs initialization

curl http://localhost:3001/api/v1/job-roles — returns array of 10 job roles (Software Developer, Data Analyst, Frontend Developer, Backend Developer, Full Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, QA Engineer, Product Manager, Business Analyst, UI/UX Designer)
Check backend logs for 'Nest application successfully started' without errors
